preToolUse.description: Block git push/deploy without build verification
preToolUse.command: bash -c 'if [[ "$COMMAND" =~ (git\ push|vercel.*deploy) ]]; then echo "🛑 Pre-deploy validation..."; cd dashboard 2>/dev/null && { npm run build > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 || { echo "❌ BUILD FAILED:"; tail -20 /tmp/build.log; exit 1; }; echo "✅ Build passed"; } || echo "⚠️  Not in dashboard directory, skipping build check"; fi'

preToolUse.description: Validate MCP tool usage in sub-agents
preToolUse.command: bash -c 'if echo "$PROMPT" | grep -qE "(mcp__supabase|mcp__google-ads|mcp__merchant|mcp__Apify)" && ! echo "$PROMPT" | grep -q "ToolSearch"; then echo "⚠️  WARNING: Prompt mentions MCP tools but no ToolSearch instruction."; echo "💡 Sub-agents must use: ToolSearch to load mcp__ tools first"; echo "💡 OR gather MCP data in main context and pass file paths to agents"; fi'

preToolUse.description: Warn about import removal during edits
preToolUse.command: bash -c 'if echo "$OLD_STRING" | grep -q "^import" && ! echo "$NEW_STRING" | grep -q "import"; then echo "⚠️  Import removed. Verify it is truly unused before proceeding."; fi'

postToolUse.command: bash -c 'cd dashboard 2>/dev/null && { npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -25 | grep -E "(error TS|✓|Found 0 errors)" || echo "✅ No type errors"; } || echo "⚠️  Not in dashboard directory"'

postToolUse.description: Remind about CLAUDE.md updates after commits
postToolUse.command: echo "💡 Session ending? Remember to update CLAUDE.md with learnings"

sessionEnd.command:
echo "
📋 Session ending checklist:
- [ ] Update CLAUDE.md with new patterns/learnings?
- [ ] Write continuation prompt if work is unfinished?
- [ ] All builds passing locally?"
